name: Farmacia Rex
description: Uruguayan online pharmacy selling health and pharmacy products, dermocosmetics, perfumery and makeup, personal care, nutrition, orthopedics, baby products and home items. Ships nationwide and offers free pickup at its Montevideo stores.
description_es: Farmacia online uruguaya con productos de salud y farmacia, dermocosmética, perfumería y maquillaje, cuidado personal, nutrición, ortopedia, mamá y bebé y hogar. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro sin costo en sus locales de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide via DAC (48 to 72 business hours after dispatch); free from $2.000 per shipping policy; same-day own delivery in Montevideo per home page

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at the Rivera 3648 store in Montevideo, coordinated in advance; ID required; prescription products ship only after the prescription is validated

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shopify store. The home page also lists a second pickup location (Farmacia De Marco, Montevideo). Product listings are for shopping information only.

sources.supports: home page: categories, brands, shipping banner, pickup locations
shipping policy: DAC, costs, times, pickup
